Checked as secondary candidate discovery only; no item was accepted without primary-source verification.
ACEP clinical policy page and dated official-domain search checked; no new in-window clinical policy meeting publication threshold identified.
AHA/ASA guideline and statement searches checked. The 2026 acute ischemic stroke guideline predates the recovery window; no new in-window acute-care statement meeting threshold identified.
ACC current guidance and dated October search checked. Several 2026 documents were present, but no newly dated in-window ED practice guideline outranked selected items.
AAP official search identified the September 28 pediatric UTI guideline; official guideline and PDF were reviewed and selected as a catch-up publication.
ACS trauma best-practice and 2026 standards pages checked. Current standards are operational and effective later; no new in-window clinical guideline selected.
ENA practice-resource library checked; no clearly dated new in-window clinical guideline with greater ED practice impact identified.
SAEM GRACE page checked; latest listed GRACE-5 is from 2025, with no new in-window GRACE guideline.
AAEM statements searched; current items were primarily workforce or organizational policy and did not meet clinical inclusion threshold.
ASH guideline pages checked. A 2026 ITP guideline page was identified, but an in-window first-online date and ED-acute-bleeding applicability were not established; retained for further review.
CHEST current guideline pages and October material checked; no new in-window acute ED guideline meeting threshold identified.
SCCM and Surviving Sepsis Campaign pages checked. The 2026 adult SSC guideline predates this initial 30-day discovery window; VASSPR was separately selected as new evidence.
IDSA current guideline pages checked. Recent COVID, histoplasmosis, and S aureus bacteremia updates were published before the September 27 recovery-window start.
ACMT position and practice statements checked; no newly dated in-window toxicology statement meeting threshold identified.
EAST current PMGs checked. A 2026 BCVI update is listed without a verified in-window publication date in the retrieved page; retained for follow-up rather than published.
ESO guideline directory and dated search checked; no newly verified in-window guideline meeting threshold identified.
ACOG clinical updates and obstetric emergency resources checked; no new in-window ED-facing obstetric guideline meeting threshold identified.
ERC guideline page checked; current resuscitation guideline set is 2025, with no new 2026 guideline identified.
